full scope.definition_en: the complete extent, range, or scale of something
full scope.example_en: Investigators are still trying to determine the full scope of the incident.
full scope.example_zh: 調查人員仍在試圖釐清這起事件的完整範圍。

sift through.definition_en: to examine a large amount of information carefully in order to find what is useful or important
sift through.example_en: The team sifted through thousands of records to identify the source of the error.
sift through.example_zh: 團隊仔細檢視數千筆紀錄，以找出錯誤的來源。

opt out.definition_en: to choose not to participate in or be included in something
opt out.example_en: Users can opt out of sharing their data for research purposes.
opt out.example_zh: 使用者可以選擇不將自己的資料分享作研究用途。
